rationale: Composite mirrors the 8 skill channels the portal actually returns for Heart extrap (registry header: de, dir, mmd_u, vario, d2, occ, scale, nmmd). Equal weights. Directions verified from scorer source docstrings (third_party/veckit/common/{core_metrics,shape_metrics}.py, third_party/veckit/T2/metrics.py), NOT from portal ordering.
formula: gain_c = dir_c * (value_c - baseline_c)/baseline_c, winsorized to +/-winsor; COMPOSITE = 100 * mean(gain_c over 8 channels). Baseline composite = 0.0 by construction.

channels.source: core_metrics.variogram_score docstring: 'Lower is better; 0 for a perfect match' -> CORRECTED 2026-10-01 (Route B had this inverted)
shape_metrics.occupancy_dice docstring: 'higher is better, 1 = same occupied region'
shape_metrics.scale_log_ratio (signed; 0 = right size) -> abs() used, lower better

guardrails.note: any violation => discard regardless of composite (anti-Goodhart)

keep_bar.deterministic: COMPOSITE > +1.00 (i.e. > +1% mean relative gain across the 8 portal channels) AND guardrails pass
keep_bar.resampling: median of 3 seeds COMPOSITE > +1.00 AND all 3 seeds guardrail-clean
keep_bar.noise_note: deterministic designs have zero scorer noise; resampling designs inherit row-luck (measured DE band +/-0.03 in Route A) so the 3-seed rule applies
